name: POSpulse (Streetspotr community)
short: German store checks and mystery shopping with photos and GPS.
summary: POSpulse GmbH (Berlin) takes commissions for store checks, placement and promotion tracking, mystery shopping and shopper feedback at points of sale in Germany. Its Streetspotr smartphone community ('Spotr') fills a questionnaire on site and takes photos; POSpulse reviews each dataset against the order and releases accepted ones to an analytics dashboard. A quote is agreed per project; no public API is documented, though the site mentions 'Schnittstellen zu Ihren Systemen'.

pricing.model: Quote per project; the customer pays only for accepted datasets from markets actually visited
pricing.notes: AGB: contract forms on accepting the written offer; 'Der Kunde zahlt nur für angenommene Datensätze'; a 70% fee on the remaining order value applies to reductions or cancellations after contract. No prices published.

latency.typical: Collection starts within 5 working days of questionnaire confirmation
latency.notes: AGB V: data collection starts 'innerhalb von maximal 5 Werktagen'. The site says 'Ergebnisse in Echtzeit' via dashboard. The Streetspotr app page says a Spot normally must be done within 12 hours of being taken and uploaded results are reviewed within a maximum of 7 days.

delivery.basis: AGB V: 'POSpulse wird die Datenerhebung innerhalb von maximal 5 Werktagen starten'.

freshness.notes: Spotr visit the market after the order.

coverage.notes: Site and customer quotes refer to checks across Germany ('ganz Deutschland'); the Streetspotr page names only Germany. The AGB also mention out-of-home and at-home surveys.

licensing.summary: AGB V: 'Die erhobenen Datensätze gehören POSpulse' (the collected datasets belong to POSpulse), which may use them anonymised for benchmarks, industry reports, white papers and media; order-specific details are not passed to third parties. What rights the customer receives to the results (use, resale, AI training) is not stated in the AGB sections read.

auth.how_to_get: Request through the platform, by email (service@pospulse.com) or by phone; POSpulse returns a written offer (AGB II). A free demo is offered on the site.

api.notes: No API documentation found. The home page says 'Schnittstellen zu Ihren Systemen' (interfaces to your systems) are possible without detail. A customer quote on the home page also mentions a self-service tool to steer surveys. /.well-known/agent-card.json, /ucp and oauth-protected-resource returned 404.

worker_pay.model: paid per correctly and completely executed order; independent, not employees

requester.checks: AGB II: the request must not breach law (criminal, discriminatory, pornographic or racist content); POSpulse reviews each request by internal criteria and may decline to make an offer to individual customers.
requester.unknown: Whether requests aimed at a person rather than a place are blocked is not stated.

human.unknown: Spotr register as members; no identity check is described on the pages read.

application.unknown: Data is captured with the Streetspotr app, but no app or device attestation is described.

camera.unknown: No signed capture or C2PA is described.

time.method: Home page: 'GPS-Tracking, Datum-/Zeitstempeln' guarantee traceable surveys; spots are completed in a set time frame (normally 12 hours).
time.unknown: Source of the timestamp and whether it can be checked outside POSpulse are not published.

location.method: Streetspotr page: workers check in on site 'in einem Umkreis von 400m'; home page cites GPS tracking.
location.unknown: The 400 m radius is stated for the app generally, not per order; some surveys can be done from anywhere; spoofing defences are not described.

content.method: AGB V: POSpulse rejects datasets whose answers do not match the photos or are incomplete; home page adds AI image recognition and analyst quality control.
content.unknown: Review thresholds and error rates are not published; the customer receives accepted datasets, not the rejected ones.

corroboration.unknown: Multiple Spotr cover many markets but each market is visited once; no cross-check is described.

sources.claim: Services (store checks, mystery shopping, market insights, shopper feedback), Streetspotr community, GPS tracking and time stamps, AI image recognition, 'Schnittstellen', free demo
POS optimisation: placement and availability checks, promotion tracking

AGB: offer-based contract, 5 working days to start, datasets belong to POSpulse, pay only for accepted datasets, 70% cancellation fee, request rules, Spotr independent, AI services may include Anthropic
Streetspotr app page: tasks near you, 400 m check-in, normal 12-hour window, review within 7 days, Germany
